 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
2 11-12-2024 Heard learned counsels for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 324, 354, 354B, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the FIR, petitioner entered in the house of the informant and tried to molest her.
On protest, petitioner inflicted knife on her left hand and fled away after closing the door from outside.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
There is no specific overt act against the petitioner.
There is case and counter case Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82517 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 between the parties.
The wife of the petitioner had already filed a case against the informant's husband under Section 376, 379 and other allied Sections of the IPC.
5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
